intent: The small grab bar that shows a drawer's panel can be swiped.
typical_uses: The grab bar at the edge of a bottom drawer's panel

dont_use_when.situation: Showing the grab bar on a drawer's panel

invariants.text: DrawerSwipeHandle is a div hidden from assistive technology (`aria-hidden="true"`), a rounded bar in var(--border-strong) that is 2.5rem wide and 0.25rem tall on a top or bottom panel and turned upright on a left or right one; it is an affordance only, since the whole panel responds to a swipe.
Rendered through `showSwipeHandle`, it sits outside the panel's padded content region, on the panel's edge that faces the page.

good.title: The bar switched on from the root

bad.title: The bar placed by hand inside the panel
bad.why: Children of DrawerContent land in its padded content region, so the bar sits inside the padding rather than at the panel's edge; set `showSwipeHandle` on the root instead.
